description:
The fallible `VirtualPath::data("literal")` construction sites for well-known repository paths are rewritten to infallible references to the `VirtualPath` path constants.

## Background

Well-known repository paths (for example `gates.toml`, `events.jsonl`, `config.toml`, `index.json`, `rules.toml`, `invariants.toml`, `templates.toml`) are constructed at many fallible `VirtualPath::data("literal")?` call sites across the crate - in the repository-state module, the storage layer, the command layer, and validation. With the well-known paths available as `pub const` associated items on `VirtualPath`, each such site becomes an infallible const reference (`VirtualPath::GATES` and the rest), removing the `?` and its unreachable error path.

Test-fixture sites that construct arbitrary non-well-known paths (for example scratch names in unit tests) keep using the fallible constructor and are out of scope.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The fallible well-known-path `VirtualPath::data("literal")?` production sites are rewritten to infallible references to the corresponding `VirtualPath` path constants.
- [hard] REQ-02: No well-known repository path is constructed through the fallible constructor on a production path after the migration.
- [hard] REQ-03: The workspace builds and the existing tests pass unchanged.

## Notes

Test-fixture construction of arbitrary non-well-known paths is unchanged.
title: Migrate well-known path sites to VirtualPath constants
